title: The Patient Smile
author: Kestrel Vane
blurb: Sebastian Sterling, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
